The format fixtures are original white-background blue rectangles (GIF also
contains a red ellipse), 63×47 pixels. They contain no third-party artwork or
metadata and are freely redistributable under this repository's MIT license.

Generated locally with Pillow: RGB white canvas, blue rectangle (15,10)-(48,38)
in (25,90,180); JPEG quality 90 (baseline and progressive), BMP default, WebP
default. GIF second frame: red ellipse (25,8)-(50,38) in (180,50,30), duration
100ms, loop 0. Pillow is only a fixture-generation tool, not a plugin dependency.

portrait-white.png is an original geometric robot with a blue circular head,
straight arms, a dark outlined white trapezoid dress and blue rectangular feet,
on a white 658×939 canvas. It tests retention of white clothing. The wide/narrow
portrait PNGs are solid blue 1024×16 / 16×1024 rectangles. All are MIT licensed
test art, without any uploaded or third-party character imagery.
